description: This file defines an in-memory authentication session object for a demo or mock mode. It provides methods to sign in as a demo user with different roles, check if a user is signed in, get current user info, get user role, and sign out.

classes.name: AuthSession
classes.description: A singleton object managing a mock authentication session, allowing sign-in as demo users, sign-out, and queries about current user and role.

methods.name: isSignedIn
methods.description: Returns whether a user is signed in for this process.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the current signed-in user, if any.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Returns the primary role of the current user, or null if signed out.

methods.name: signInAsDemo
methods.description: Signs in a demo user with the specified email and role, creating and returning a User object.
